name: Christine Raquel Cruz-Arvayo
office: Pomona Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Christine Raquel Cruz-Arvayo is a retired school administrator running for the Pomona Unified School District Governing Board in Trustee Area 1. Her campaign says she spent 30 years working in Pomona Unified as a teacher, coach, activities director, and district administrator, most recently as a Program Administrator for Secondary Curriculum and Instruction. She also serves as a board member and clerk for the San Antonio Regional Occupational Program, representing Pomona Unified.
